checkpoint_policy: Replace current_progress and current checkpoint, do not append cumulative report trees. Record detailed scoped evidence in existing issue/PR or prior immutable Git snapshot; preserve exact commit/path/blob and relevant key. Carry forward unresolved issues only; retain older history pointer. Never infer PASS, authorize cutover or change protected runtime from compaction. Checkpoint next is subordinate to original task and current owner decision; before resumption verify exit criteria and actual missing acceptance evidence. If mismatch, correct it; do not reopen accepted scope. After each unit close a real gate or identify a concrete unresolved blocker.
